newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chinney share issue to raise HK$90 mln.
newsitem.headline: Chinney share issue to raise HK$90 mln.

text.p: Chinney Investments Ltd has agreed to place 50 million new shares at HK$1.83 per share with independent private investors, raising net proceeds of about HK$90 million, the company said in a statement.
It said it did not have any specific plans for the use of the proceeds but would consider using about 50 percent for debt repayment and the remainder for general working capital.
The new shares represent about 10.10 percent of the existing issued share capital of the company and 9.17 percent of the enlarged share capital.
Chinney Investments shares closed at HK$1.90 on Monday.
